item_desc2022051.en:
A piece of ancient, exotic jade. It is surrounded by a faint heavenly aura; perhaps it came from somewhere other than our world. According to the Master of the Manual Pavilion, it may be a kind of money adapted by residents in the Immortal Realm, just like the Spirit Stones in this world.

Give it to the Master in the Main Manual Pavilion of the Cultivator Alliance, in exchange for a chance to refresh the list of goods on the Master’s shelf.
item_desc2022051.ch:
古朴厚重、玄奥无比的玉石，其上散发着幽幽仙气，似乎不是八荒山海界的产物。据琅琊阁主推测，此物或许是仙界中如同灵石般流通的货币。

可在仙盟琅琊主阁处，使用该物品与阁主交换，让其立刻上新一批货品。

item_desc2022061.en: Some wooden sticks surrounded by a faint heavenly aura. Once lit on fire, they would produce a mystic smoke that is harmless to humans but irresistible to Nether Demons. After detecting the smoke, Nether Demons will come here in haste, and will be enthralled.
item_desc2022061.ch: 散发出淡淡仙气的木材，点燃后会产生奇异烟雾，这种烟雾对人类毫无影响，却对冥妖有着致命的吸引力，冥妖会在闻到此烟后立刻赶往此地并进入迷幻状态。

item_desc2022071.en:
Treasure from the Mystic Realm centuries ago. They are a collection of secret martial arts mastered by ancient sects. Blurred words like "Hall of Divine Spirits" and "Dozens of Thousands of Miraculous Arts" are written on the title page, but their table of content is mostly illegible. There are only a dozen chapters that remain readable in them. Some legends said that the ancient mystic realm is an incredible place full of esoteric treasures, and famous sects in the ancient world always fought against each other for them. Their battle caused huge causalities, but the realm is nowhere to be found now - maybe it exists only in rumors and stories.

This item is extremely rare, once comprehended by the <g>Sect Leader</g>, they can replace the <g>Rewrite Destiny</g> effect of their Sect in the Spirit Pavilion.
item_desc2022071.ch:
上古秘境中传出之至宝，记载着八荒远古大宗的秘法，扉页隐约能看见“通灵宝殿”、“逆天之法万余”等字样，然而其目录记载之字眼大多不可辨识，勉强可读的章节只剩十余篇。据传说上古秘境玄奥之极，八荒各大远古宗门曾为其中之宝征战不休、伤亡惨重，但此秘境现已不知所踪，徒留后人遐想。

此物稀世罕见，<g>宗主</g>参悟后可更改本宗灵阁内的<g>逆天改命</g>。

item_desc2022111.en:
You may use an Enigmatic Stone in Qi Refining to learn Manuals in its same realm. Enigmatic Stones of higher quality may affect more affixes.
<g>●To use it, open the manual you want to learn, and click on [Merge Insights].
●You need to keep your Taoist Mind Dedication above a threshold to gain insights from the Stone. You may check your Dedication by pressing J and clicking on the Taoist's Lotus at the top of the interface.
●You need to have skills of the same type before learning a specific manual with the Stone.</g>

(This is a special item for Gourd Imps and will not be displayed in your inventory. You may find it in the inventory of the Mythical Gourd interface and feed it to your Imps)
item_desc2823001.ch: 蕴含丰富灵力的奇妙丹药，可使壶妖增加修为，通过派遣壶妖外出历练，探索获得。（壶妖专属道具，不会在角色背包中展示。你可以在炼妖界面中进行查看或对壶妖进行喂养）

item_desc2823002.en: An incredible elixir with a bluish glow of light. You could feel a strange yet delightful scent around it. Use to help the Gourd Imp in making breakthrough to the next realm. Can be obtained by the Imp from adventures and explorations. (This is a special item for Gourd Imps and will not be displayed in your inventory. You may find it in the inventory of the Mythical Gourd interface and feed it to your Imps)
item_desc2823002.ch: 闪烁幽幽蓝光并伴随异香的奇妙丹药，可助壶妖突破境界，通过派遣壶妖外出历练，探索获得。（壶妖专属道具，不会在角色背包中展示。你可以在炼妖界面中进行查看或对壶妖进行喂养）

item_desc2823003.en: The True Qi is those in the meridians. If we treat Evil Qi unwisely and apply purgative methods after the evilest Qi disappeared, the True Qi would also be dispersed, and the patient would be irreversibly weakened. Use to heal a Wounded or Dying Gourd Imp. Can be obtained by the Imp from adventures and explorations. (This is a special item for Gourd Imps and will not be displayed in your inventory. You may find it in the inventory of the Mythical Gourd interface and feed it to your Imps)
item_desc2823003.ch: 真气者，经气也。候邪不审，大气已过，泻之则真气脱，脱则不复。可治疗壶妖的重伤或濒死状态，通过派遣壶妖外出历练，探索获得。（壶妖专属道具，不会在角色背包中展示。你可以在炼妖界面中进行查看或对壶妖进行喂养）

item_desc2823004.en: Under the Heaven and above the Earth, everything communicates and transforms. An extremely rare elixir that can change the Gourd Imps with form-changing skill into human form. Can be obtained by Imps from their adventures and explorations. (This is a special item for Gourd Imps and will not be displayed in your inventory. You may find it in the inventory of the Mythical Gourd interface and feed it to your Imps)
item_desc2823004.ch: 感悟天地，万物化生。极为稀有的丹药，可令拥有化形技能的壶妖化形成人，通过派遣壶妖外出历练，探索获得。（壶妖专属道具，不会在角色背包中展示。你可以在炼妖界面中进行查看或对壶妖进行喂养）

item_desc2830717.en: A cubic artifact emanating mysterious energy. While its construction is intricate and profound, it can be easily dismantled by pulling out a single joint. Something peculiar seems to be hidden within.
item_desc2830717.ch: 萦绕着奇特气息的四方体玩物。其组合过程十分精巧玄妙，但拆解却只需轻轻抽出其中一道榫卯。当中似乎藏有什么奇特的玩意。

item_desc2831212.en: A small ornament crafted by Yin'er from various materials at hand. Though it appears to be a simple assemblage of different pieces, there's an elegant harmony to its design that seems to hint at deeper mysteries. It looks like it can be taken apart.
item_desc2831212.ch: 经过银耳利用手边物品编织的小道具，虽然看似是几样东西的缝合，但颇具天趣，似乎暗合某种至理。似乎能够拆开。

item_desc2833781.en: Round at the top and tapering to a point, this jade-like vessel resembles a heart. Within, azure flames dance with vibrant life. Though Yin'er has fallen, this heart seems to remain alive.
item_desc2833781.ch: 其形圆而下尖，恍似心脏，材质如玉，当中可见幽蓝光焰活泼泼的跳动着。银耳虽已身陨，但一颗心脏似乎仍旧存活。

item_desc2833782.en: Herbal scents emanate from within. Beneath its outer shell lies what seems to be a precious elixir.

item_desc2_6083060.en: A peculiar breath is emitted that draws strange monsters to gather in the vicinity.
item_desc2_6083060.ch: 散发特殊的气息，引来不明的妖兽聚集在附近。

item_desc2_6092020.en: Unleash the power of lightning from the charm to cover oneself, gaining bonus Agility for a while and dealing Lightning damage to enemies touched. The charm contains tremendous Lightning power, and anyone using it will be unable to cast any skill or use any item under its effect. Meanwhile, lightning bolts will also be summoned to strike the charm's user; the bolts will also inflict damage on other units.
item_desc2_6092020.ch: 释放符纸内的雷电之力覆盖自身，使移动速度上升，并给予触碰自身的敌人造成雷属性伤害，持续一段时间。期间由于雷电之力的影响，使用者将无法使用技能和道具，同时会不间断引发雷劫劈向自身，造成伤害；若命中其他单位，也会造成伤害。

item_desc2_6092030.en: Consume its user's Energy to generate a shield in a duration.
item_desc2_6092030.ch: 吸收使用者的灵力，转化为保护自身的护盾，持续一段时间。

item_desc2_6092040.en: Use it to connect with the deceased and summon them into the battlefield as your minions.
item_desc2_6092040.ch: 以符为媒介，沟通亡者，使之听从号令出现在战场内！

item_desc2_6092050.en: Use it to link to the Earth's veins and form a soul cage. Units inside the cage will be captured and attack your enemies for a duration.
item_desc2_6092050.ch: 以符之力，沟通地脉，锁住范围内生灵的部分灵魂之力，使之自动攻击你的敌人，持续一段时间。

item_desc2_6093010.en: Unleash the power of land vein to mark the tile under feet. Teleport by opening the region map and clicking on the Mark icon.
item_desc2_6093010.ch: 沟通地脉之力标记脚下格子，打开小地图单击标记图标可进行传送。

item_desc2_6093020.en: The talisman is burned to connect with Feng Shui and spiritual veins of heaven and earth and form a natural Confusion Array. Once trapped in it, nobody can find their way out.
item_desc2_6093020.ch: 燃烧符纸沟通天地风水灵脉，以形成天然迷惑大阵，陷入其中将很难离开。

item_desc2_6093040.en: Connecting with the Power of the Divine Eye expands the vision and enables one to detect things that are not easily perceptible, but sometimes one may get caught up in some undesirable things.
item_desc2_6093040.ch: 沟通神目之力使视野拓展，能发现常人无法觉察到的情况，但有时也会被不好的东西缠上。

item_desc2_6093050.en: Set up an altar to connect with the power of heaven and earth and change the weather!
item_desc2_6093050.ch: 设下法坛，沟通天地之力，改变天气！
